t: SigStory boots a whole library in one click
title: SigStory boots a whole library in one click
description: The Signature Story Engine is a Signature original: a local-model interface that boots an entire library of Signature stories, characters, and presets with one click. Where the public UI makes you configure loaders and folders by hand, SigStory auto-detects installed models, picks the fastest backend for the hardware it finds, and presents a ready shelf of Signature characters. It is an original Signature design, not a copy of any public tool.

demo.program:
print('SigStory: scan models/ -> pick fastest backend -> shelf ready')
print('edition: Signature original')
demo.expected_output:
SigStory: scan models/ -> pick fastest backend -> shelf ready
edition: Signature original

title: SigLoader unified backend
description: SigLoader is SigStory's original unified loader layer: instead of exposing a dozen backends, it profiles the model file (format, size, quantization) and the machine (VRAM, RAM, CPU threads) and routes to the best engine automatically. Users can still pin a backend per model, but the default is a decision, not a dropdown. Signature original design.

demo.program:
spec={'format':'EXL2','vram_gb':12}
print('SigLoader routes',spec,'to fastest engine automatically')
demo.expected_output: SigLoader routes {'format': 'EXL2', 'vram_gb': 12} to fastest engine automatically

title: Story shelves instead of folders
description: SigStory replaces raw folders with story shelves: curated collections (mystery shelf, sci-fi shelf, study shelf) that bundle a character set, a preset, and an instruct template that were tuned together. Installing a shelf is one file drop, and everything inside it already agrees with everything else. This is a Signature-original organization idea.

title: SigCast character format
description: SigCast is the Signature character format: a character card plus voice settings, memory notes, and a relationship map to other characters on the same shelf. Characters remember shelf-level facts (who met whom) so multi-character stories stay consistent. Original Signature format, documented in the SigStory spec.

demo.program:
card={'name':'Nova','voice':'warm','memory':['met Kai in ch.2']}
print('SigCast card:',card['name'],'| memory entries:',len(card['memory']))

title: SigAPI local endpoint
description: SigAPI mirrors the familiar chat-completions shape so existing scripts work, but adds Signature extensions: shelf context injection, character memory endpoints, and generation receipts (which preset/template/seed produced each reply). Every reply can be reproduced exactly from its receipt. Signature-original API design.

title: Preset tuner with live A/B
description: The preset tuner runs the same prompt through two presets side by side and shows both outputs with tokens/sec, so tuning stops being guesswork. Winning settings save as a new preset with one click, and the tuner keeps a history of every comparison. Original Signature workflow.

title: SigExtensions sandbox
description: SigExtensions run in a sandbox with declared permissions (network, filesystem, microphone), shown in the UI before you enable one. A misbehaving extension can be killed without restarting the server, and its permission grants are per-session. This permission-first design is original to SigStory.

title: Shelf downloader
description: The downloader fetches whole shelves (characters, presets, templates, sample models) as one signed bundle and verifies the signature before installing. Partial downloads resume, and bundles install into the shelf tree without touching user files. Signature-original distribution format.

title: SigQuant smart quantization picker
description: SigQuant inspects free VRAM and picks the heaviest quantization that fits with headroom for context, then explains the choice in plain language. If the user later frees VRAM, one click re-picks. The picker logic and its explanations are Signature-original.

demo.program:
free=10.0
pick='EXL2 5.0bpw' if free>8 else 'GGUF Q4'
print('free VRAM',free,'GB ->',pick)

title: Template matcher
description: The template matcher reads a model's config and README hints and suggests the instruct template the model was trained with, with a confidence score. A wrong-template warning appears before generation, not after bad output. Original Signature feature.

title: SigBench built-in benchmark runs
description: SigBench runs a standard prompt battery against every installed model and keeps a leaderboard (tokens/sec, quality votes, VRAM used). Results are stored per model file hash, so re-downloaded models do not need re-benchmarking. Signature-original benchmark harness.

title: SigTrain one-click adapters
description: SigTrain wraps adapter training in a three-screen wizard: pick base, pick shelf dataset, pick style strength. It validates the dataset (format, size, license note) before spending GPU time, and trained adapters attach to shelves automatically. Original Signature workflow.

title: Hot-swap with session carryover
description: SigStory hot-swaps models mid-conversation and carries a compressed session summary into the new model so the story continues coherently. The summary is shown to the user and editable before the swap completes. Signature-original session handoff.

title: SigGuard memory watchdog
description: SigGuard watches VRAM during generation and, before an OOM crash, pauses and offers fixes: drop context, switch quant, or offload layers — with the exact VRAM each fix frees. It turns crashes into a dialog box. Original Signature design.
